title: Universal Transcriber Domain Playbook Schema (v1)
description: JSON Schema v7 specification for Universal Transcriber domain playbooks.

version.description: Version string for the playbook definition (e.g. 'v1', 'v2').

description.description: Human-readable description of the domain context.

default_role.description: Default speaker label assigned when no specific role or roster match triggers.

roles.description: List of recognized roles in this conversational domain.

cues.description: Mapping of role keys to conversational trigger phrases.

default_roster.description: List of known participant names for automated entity linking.

chair_roles.description: Roles that possess parliamentary presiding authority (e.g. Chair, President).

affirmative_cues.description: Phrases signaling vote assent or attendance confirmation in roll calls.

negative_cues.description: Phrases signaling vote dissent or absence in roll calls.
